conversation.message: Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence where systems learn from data to identify patterns and make predictions without explicit programming. It allows computers to improve their performance on a task over time through experience.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It really is. So, what are some of the main types of machine learning?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The three main types are supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning, each with distinct approaches to data.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Could you explain the differences between those three types?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly. Supervised learning uses labeled data, unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data, and reinforcement learning involves an agent learning through trial and error with rewards.
